card.text: Young companion about 100 au from GQ Lup, still feeding from a disc of its own.

sources.label: Stolker et al. 2021
sources.quote: expected to trace continuum emission from small grains in a protolunar disk

introduction.text: GQ Lup b is a hot, young companion of about 30 Jupiter masses, still growing from a disc of its own. VLTI/GRAVITY has pinned its position to a fraction of a milliarcsecond.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
